**Finding: deviation (LICENSE — licence grant scope)**

The grant fails the playbook's fallback on two material terms:

1. **Affiliates/contractors excluded.** The grant in ¶p0030 runs to "Licensee" only, and ¶p0045 prohibits access "by any individuals other than the employees of the Licensee" (reinforced by ¶p0041, ¶p0042 and Article VI at ¶p0085). The only route to add Affiliates or our contractors is Licensor's discretionary prior written consent — below the fallback of "Affiliates covered on written notice."
2. **No successor transfer.** ¶p0149 bars assignment without Licensor's consent with no M&A carve-out, and Article XX (¶p0134) auto-terminates the licence on a Change of Control unless Licensor consents, with broad "deemed reasonable to withhold" grounds.

The licence is not revocable at will on its face (36-month initial term), so I did not pursue the no-cure termination right in Article IV under this rule (better addressed under a termination rule).

**Redline validated (ok:true)** — three minimal edits at the preferred position: extend the grant to "its Affiliates and its contractors acting on Licensee's behalf," conform the employee-only restriction in ¶p0045, and add a consent-free successor-assignment proviso in ¶p0149. Fallback of Affiliate use on written notice is offered in the comment.
